Market today: The mood is cautious as the 10-year Treasury yield hit a 2002 high, signaling a global bond rout. This is the real driver, making future earnings less valuable and increasing borrowing costs, which directly pressures your tech and chip names. 

Your holdings: SOXL (-34.21%) and SPAL (-31.89%) are both 'SELL' status, deeply in the red, and leveraged. These are major concerns, especially with margin amplifying any further drops. 

Watch: Keep a close eye on bond yields; continued increases will pressure your tech-heavy book. Also, monitor your stops on leveraged positions. 

Bottom line: Prioritize aggressive risk management on your leveraged losers in this challenging rate environment.
plays: Review SOXL and SPAL: Both are 'SELL' status, leveraged, and deeply in the red. Consider trimming or tightening stops given market volatility and margin.
